data.name: 5.0.9: Maintenance Release
data.body:
## What's Changed
* Verify resolveMerge is called for valid files pending conflict resolution by @knolleary in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/5996
* Fix crash on comms auth packet when adminAuth is not set by @sankalpsthakur in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/5988
* Fix filter node blocking every Date payload by @sarmah-rup in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/5990
* Support node:-prefixed core modules in parseModuleName by @shubhamrai9122-creator in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/5993
* chore: update monaco editor to 0.57.0 by @Steve-Mcl in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/5992
* feat: add JavaScript and CSS support to script and style blocks in HT… by @Steve-Mcl in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/5994
* Fix CSV array output for independent sequence elements by @Anthounn in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/5978
* Range node: drop non-numeric input instead of coercing it by @JMBMdes in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/5976
* Allow empty object first for RBE by @hardillb in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/6000
* Fix CSV node to remove initial BOM char by @dceejay in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/5864
* fix: default editor theme to auto by @AkhilTrivediX in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/5873
* Add the *error* badge to the flow tab by @GogoVega in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/5950
* Add a fallback lookup for esm only modules by @knolleary in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/6003
* Allow flows to be drag-ordered in explorer sidebar by @knolleary in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/6004
* Add badges to the Explorer sidebar by @GogoVega in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/5951
* Emit nodes:change when a nodes moved state changes by @knolleary in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/6006
* fix: include embedded script and style errors in getAnnotations by @Steve-Mcl in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/6015
* Fix the subflow's 'changed' state when its content is modified by @GogoVega in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/6023
* Fix invalid SSH key name error code by @NUAAwqy in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/6026
* Fix quick-add dialog moving instead of closing when clicking the workspace by @NUAAwqy in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/6027
* Fix contextMenu for the internal nodes of subflow by @GogoVega in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/6025
* Fix MQTT connect action dropping its url when repeated by @sankalpsthakur in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/6019
* Bump for 5.0.9 by @knolleary in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/6028

## New Contributors
* @sarmah-rup made their first contribution in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/5990
* @shubhamrai9122-creator made their first contribution in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/5993
* @Anthounn made their first contribution in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/5978
* @JMBMdes made their first contribution in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/5976
* @AkhilTrivediX made their first contribution in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/5873
* @NUAAwqy made their first contribution in https://github.com/node-red/node-red/pull/6026

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/node-red/node-red/compare/5.0.8...5.0.9

Bump for 5.0.9

+ - Add the *error* badge to the flow tab (#5950) @GogoVega
+ - fix: default editor theme to auto (#5873) @AkhilTrivediX

+ - Allow empty object first for RBE (#6000) @hardillb
+ - Range node: drop non-numeric input instead of coercing it (#5976) @JMBMdes
+ - Fix CSV array output for independent sequence elements (#5978) @Anthounn
+ - feat: add JavaScript and CSS support to script and style blocks in HT… (#5994) @Steve-Mcl

  - Docs: document msg.reset behaviour for tcp out/request nodes (#5968)
